title: RetentionPolicy
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.RetentionPolicy). A versioned retention schedule for one record class in one organization. (policy_id, policy_version) is unique and append-only: superseding always creates a NEW version and sets supersedes_policy_version; a previous version's row is never rewritten, so what a past disposal decision was made under stays answerable. Every timestamp is timezone-aware ISO-8601 (RFC 3339) with an explicit offset. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
